decisions.reason: The cobot loading system was launched only in 2024 and fits the automation trend in machine tending, so a short record with no clear shortfall against aspirations gives no trigger for problemistic search and little reason to drop it this early.

The dual-table loading system is a low-cost complement to the firm's milling machines that shares its resources, so even with modest results the firm's slack lets it carry the product while its performance is still uncertain.
The dispensing machine has its own product page and won a Red Dot Design Award in 2024, which signals results above aspiration and strong commitment, making withdrawal very unlikely.
